Name: Vibing Fish
Author: EnbyFelix
Description:
I am currently watching The Price of Perfection by ArgonMatrix. (It is very good, y'all should watch it if you haven't already.) In one of the videos, he misreads "thriving" as "vibing", and he says he wishes the fish pond status would say "vibing" instead of "thriving". So I was inspired by that to make this mod.


It should be compatible with any mod that doesn't change that specific line, and I don't know of any that do. If you find any incompatibilities, let me know.

Update: changed more of the fish pond messages.

Now 1.6 compatible!

Downloads.Description: Changes some of the fish pond messages to use some current slang. Updated to 1.6!
